chunks: We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Ahmad bin Idrees, that he said: We were told by Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Yahya bin Imran al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad bin Isa bin Ubayd, from Hasan bin Rashid, that he said: I asked Abu'l-Hasan al-Askari, peace be upon him, in Medina about a man who bequeathed his wealth for the Path of Allah. He said: The Path of Allah is our Shi'a.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Askari define as the 'Path of Allah' in the context of bequest?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Mani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Askari (peace be upon him) provides a specific jurisprudential definition of 'Sabil Allah' (Path of God) by identifying it with the Shia community, thereby elevating the status of the Imams' followers in matters of charity. This interpretation shifts the concept from a general spiritual state to a tangible communal identity, establishing that supporting the Shia is tantamount to supporting God's cause. Such a definition underscores the theological centrality of the Ahl al-Bayt's followers in Islamic jurisprudence and social organization.
